title: alchemilla flabellata subsp. carniolica
intro: Alchemilla flabellata subsp. carniolica, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla flabellata subsp. carniolica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and wound-healing properties.
